what_the_data_actually_says.permutation_destroys_the_gain: the permuted arm gains nothing (+1.50 ns and -0.14 ns), exactly as a clean feature should behave
what_the_data_actually_says.real_mapping_matters_where_power_exists: in one_unseen the real gain exceeds the permuted gain by +2.36 pp [+0.29,+4.43]
what_the_data_actually_says.where_it_is_merely_directional: in both_unseen the same contrast is +1.57 pp [-0.14,+3.64], right direction but only about 1,830 keys

criticism_of_my_own_gate: requiring significance in every pool makes the gate unsatisfiable for a small pool; a combined or power-weighted criterion would have been the right pre-registration. Recorded so the next gate is designed against power.
